# Nonprivate Gemini protocol fixtures

Generated entirely offline with eSpeak NG through espeakng-loader 0.2.4.
No person was recorded, no cloned voice or paid synthesis service was used.
PCM16 mono / 16 kHz, padded with silence to exactly 15 seconds each.

Indonesian: "Ini adalah uji terjemahan suara. Besok pagi kami akan bertemu di
perpustakaan. Tolong bawa tiga buku dan sebotol air."

English: "This is a voice translation test. Tomorrow morning we will meet at the
library. Please bring three books and a bottle of water."

These fixtures test the backend protocol. They cannot establish microphone,
Android speaker/headset echo behavior, pronunciation quality or audible latency.
